main_idea: GRPO lifts DeepSWE pass@1 from 27.8% to 39.1%
ideas: GRPO raised DeepSWE pass@1 from 27.8% to 39.1%
Gain is +11.3 points over the base model
Evaluation uses the same setup for both models
summary: The result bars are clear, but the dashboard adds a repeated 39.1% stat, a dataset stats row, a training reward chart, a task-type bar and an entropy footer that all dilute the one 27.8%-to-39.1% comparison; the subtitle is also wordy. Nothing essential is missing.
